_comment: WIND-UP CENSUS arm (SPEC_phase_windup_sign 10.4).  Knob-verbatim clone of
_fld63_relevel4h_ctlw plus estimation.trace_windup_census -- a READ-ONLY counter set,
so this arm is byte-identical to the control on every solve artifact and needs no A/B:
it is a single measurement on the canonical FRACTIONAL field posture (the posture every
field lineage runs, and the one no instrument has ever reached on the network path --
windup_trace.csv is written only from Application::run).
PRE-REGISTERED: (1) wraps per station per day near SPEC 7's measured 43 (GCGO, 24 h);
materially below => the census under-counts, check steps against the epoch count first;
materially above => 7's single-station figure did not generalise and its 63-station
scaling is an UNDERestimate.  (2) gap_wu_to_carry is THE number that decides the
accumulate_phase_windup default: zero on a settled run => the inverted-horizon hole has
an empty population on this posture and the flip can be argued on 9.5's residual algebra
alone; nonzero => a wired restart response is a BLOCKING prerequisite and no accumulate
arm runs until it lands.  (3) restarts must be 0 here (fractional mode has no
accumulator).  (4) steps == 0 on an armed run is dead wiring, not a null (invariant #4).
NOTE the horizon ordering: this chain sets phase_leveling_max_gap_s 900 > the 300 s
wind-up horizon, so the exposure bucket IS meaningful here.  On a config taking the
120 s loader default the ordering inverts and the teardown suppresses the narrative.
